crossRefs.note: Now king Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites…
In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and…
Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them…
Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of…
Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God, and I don’t desire…

translations.web: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.
translations.bsb: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.
translations.kjv: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
translations.asv: And so did he for all his foreign wives, who burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
